home.pageTitle: Taste Vietnam | Discover Vietnam Through Food
home.heroDesc: Explore authentic Vietnamese dishes, regional specialties and the stories behind every bite.
home.introTitleHtml:
More Than Food.
It's a Story of Vietnam.
home.introText: Vietnamese cuisine is a journey through culture, history and everyday life. From a bowl of steaming Pho in Hanoi to the vibrant flavors of the Mekong Delta, every dish tells a story worth discovering.
home.regionsDesc: Discover how geography and culture shape the flavors of Vietnamese cuisine.
home.cultureTitleHtml:
Every Dish Has
a Story to Tell.
home.cultureP1: Food in Vietnam is more than something to eat. It brings families together, connects generations and reflects the identity of every region.
home.cultureP2: Explore the stories, traditions and people behind Vietnam's most beloved dishes.

about.aboutIntro: Taste Vietnam helps international travelers explore Vietnamese cuisine by region, save favorites, and plan meals.
about.purposeText: Discover local flavors, one dish at a time. Our website helps you discover delicious local dishes, interesting food spots, and unique culinary experiences across Vietnam.
about.whoText: For curious food lovers. Whether you're a traveler looking for what to eat, a foodie searching for new flavors, or simply someone who loves discovering Vietnamese cuisine, this website is for you.
about.teamText: Made by a small team with a big love for food. We created this website to share our passion for Vietnamese cuisine and make it easier for everyone to discover great food and memorable culinary experiences.
